description: Freeway Traffic Incident Detection Dataset is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Junchao Ye, Xiang Hong. "This dataset introduces a comprehensive, large-scale, and fully labeled benchmark designed to advance freeway traffic incident detection and imbalanced learning research, derived from the TraffiDent dataset [1]. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
